customers.description: Registered shoppers (clients, buyers, users) of a UK online grocery shop: name, email, UK city, UK region, postcode area, signup date and whether the account is active.

columns.is_active: true if the account is still active
columns.region: nation within the UK: England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland
columns.postcode_area: first part of the customer's UK postcode, for example M4 or EH1

suppliers.description: UK companies that supply the shop's products (vendors, wholesalers) with their city and UK region.

columns.region: nation within the UK: England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland

categories.description: Product categories (departments, product groups) such as Dairy and Eggs, Bakery or Drinks.

products.description: Grocery items sold in the shop (goods, SKUs): name, category, supplier, selling price in pounds, cost, stock and whether discontinued.

columns.unit_price: current list price in pounds sterling
columns.unit_cost: what the shop pays its supplier for one unit, in pounds

coupons.description: Discount codes (promotions, vouchers) with a percentage and validity dates.

orders.description: Customer orders (purchases, baskets): customer, date, status, sales channel and optional coupon. Contains no money amounts; amounts come from order_items.

order_items.description: Products on each order with quantity and the price actually paid per unit. Revenue or sales value is quantity * unit_price.

columns.unit_price: price paid per unit, can differ from products.unit_price

payments.description: Payments for orders: date, method, amount and payment status.

columns.amount: amount charged for the whole order

shipments.description: Delivery of completed orders: carrier, shipped date and delivered date (delivery, dispatch, courier).

returns.description: Items sent back by customers with date and reason (refund requests, returned goods).

reviews.description: Customer ratings (1 to 5) of products with date (feedback, stars).
